one_liner: Bold, English-peppered girl raised in America who declares herself the future Queen of the Tiara.
personality: Daring Heart is confident, flashy and a natural leader who loves being watched, mixing English into almost every line. She is also serious about steady self-improvement ('always be the best me') and refuses to indulge herself when off form, hating to show weakness. She flirts and teases the trainer, praising their analysis and claiming she was the one who 'noticed' them first, and she looks after friends like her roommate Pandora (hairbrush, homework) and Kraft, who dozes off to her guitar.

story_arc.summary: Raised in the United States, Heart comes to Tracen aiming to become the Queen of the Triple Tiara. Her goals run Hanshin JF, Fillies' Review, Oka Sho, NHK Mile Cup, Shuka Sho, Hanshin Uma Musume S, Victoria Mile, Queen S, Fuchu Uma Musume S and Mile CS, with event titles like 'My Brilliant Rivals', 'Becoming Someone New?' and 'Just the Way I Am'. Her character story titles ('Moon in the Sunshine', 'Eclipse of Sun and Moon') suggest a sun/moon rivalry theme; details are not in the mdb.
